newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH BG BANK ENTERS MORTGAGE CREDIT PACT.
newsitem.headline: DANISH BG BANK ENTERS MORTGAGE CREDIT PACT.

text.p: Denmark's BG Bank said on Friday it made a nationwide cooperation deal with BRFkredit, the country's third largest mortgage credit firm, effective September 1.
"The nationwide cooperation arrangement means that BG Babk will earn commission for processing mortgage credit loans for BRFkredit," BRFkredit said in a statement.
It said the pact was part of its strategy to cooperate more with banks, which did not have their own mortgage credit institution.

BG Bank, Denmark's third biggest bank, already cooperates on mortgage credit with the country's two biggest firms in the sector, Nykredit and Realkredit Danmark. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
